w:r.w:t: SanFreight Logistics is an international logistics partner delivering integrated freight forwarding and supply chain solutions across global markets.

With expertise spanning ocean freight, air freight, customs clearance, transportation, warehousing, and specialized project logistics, we help businesses move cargo with confidence, efficiency, and precision.

Built on strong global partnerships and industry experience, our team develops tailored logistics strategies that simplify complex supply chains while meeting the highest standards of reliability and operational excellence.
From routine shipments to highly specialized cargo, every solution is designed around our clients' unique requirements, ensuring timely delivery, complete visibility, and long-term value.
As global trade continues to evolve, we remain committed to delivering smarter logistics solutions that support sustainable business growth across every destination.
Years of industry experience delivering reliable logistics solutions backed by operational excellence and trusted global partnerships.
Successful shipments managed across international markets with precision, efficiency, and dependable execution.

Ocean Freight That Connects Global Trade.
We provide reliable ocean freight solutions designed to keep your supply chain moving efficiently across international markets.

Whether you require Full Container Load (FCL) or Less than Container Load (LCL) services, our experienced team delivers tailored shipping solutions backed by strong partnerships with leading global carriers.
Comprehensive FCL and LCL services across major international trade routes.
Flexible shipping solutions designed around your cargo, timelines, and business requirements.
Reliable coordination from origin to destination with complete shipment visibility.
Air Freight When Time Matters Most.
Our air freight services are built for businesses that require speed, reliability, and complete peace of mind.
From urgent consignments to temperature-sensitive and high-value cargo, we ensure every shipment reaches its destination safely and on schedule.
Fast and dependable global air freight solutions.
Specialized handling for critical, fragile, and temperature-controlled cargo.
Real-time shipment tracking with proactive operational support.
International trade requires precision, compliance, and experience. Our customs specialists simplify complex clearance procedures to keep your cargo moving.
From documentation and regulatory compliance to inspections and duty processing, we manage every stage with efficiency and accuracy.
Experienced customs professionals ensuring regulatory compliance.
Efficient documentation and clearance for import and export shipments.
Reduced delays through proactive customs coordination.
Efficient logistics extends beyond freight movement. We provide transportation and warehousing solutions that strengthen every stage of your supply chain.
With secure storage, nationwide transportation, and coordinated distribution, we help businesses improve operational efficiency and delivery performance.
Secure warehousing designed for efficient inventory management.
Reliable transportation solutions across diverse cargo categories.
Integrated logistics support from storage to final delivery.
Some shipments require more than standard logistics. Our specialized teams manage complex cargo with precision, planning, and technical expertise.
From breakbulk and project cargo to hazardous materials, perishable shipments, and ISO tank logistics, we deliver customized solutions for every challenge.
Expert handling of project cargo, breakbulk, and oversized shipments.
Specialized logistics for hazardous, temperature-controlled, and sensitive cargo.
Tailored planning and execution backed by experienced logistics professionals.
